name: ell-tls-secret-memset
fixed_note: all: Replace uses of memset with explicit_bzero - TLS pre-master secrets and PRF seeds in local arrays, a DH private key and decrypted PEM content wiped before l_free(), settings values wiped before l_free(): memset() of memory never read again is a dead store the compiler may delete. The wipes of tls->pending/fixed_iv (kept in the object) and of l_key_extract's payload (the caller's buffer) were changed too but cannot be removed, and are not reported.
args_note: ell of 2019 relied on implicit declarations of the string functions, an error since clang 16; the fix commit also uses explicit_bzero before the header fix cc3f62b
